artifacts.decision: Recalculate critical path for PRG7 after task T-4419 update; path unchanged, total float 14d.

basis.detail: 412 activities, 3 open constraint violations, none on the critical path
Remaining duration changed 12d to 15d, actual start 2026-08-17
Baseline finish 2026-09-30, baseline total float 14d

alternatives.option: Flag the change as a critical path shift
alternatives.rejected_because: Forward and backward pass both return the same critical path; float on T-4419 remains 9d, above the 0d threshold.

confidence_and_failure_mode.failure_mode: If the P6 network export is stale, the recalculation runs on a superseded logic set and the unchanged verdict is wrong. Detectable by comparing network version v88 against the P6 change log on the next sync at 09:00.
confidence_and_failure_mode.calibration_basis: Deterministic. Verified against P6 native scheduler on 1,000 networks, 2026-Q2, zero disagreements.

reversal.how: Re-run the forward and backward pass against the corrected network export and re-issue the float report to the programme scheduler.
reversal.cheap_until_reason: Weekly float report distribution to programme leads.

artifacts.decision: Categorise slip on milestone MS-PRG7-014 as supplier-caused, 11 working days, absorbed by float.

basis.detail: Baseline finish 2026-09-30, float 14d
Supplier confirmed delay in writing 2026-08-15
SLA clause 7.2, notification requirement met

alternatives.rejected_because: No approved change request in the window. CR-PRG7-0088 closed 2026-07-02.
Remaining float 3d after absorption, above the 2d escalation threshold.

confidence_and_failure_mode.failure_mode: If the supplier delay is a symptom of an undisclosed resource loss on their side, the 11-day figure understates the slip and float absorption is wrong. Detectable at the next supplier checkpoint on 2026-08-26.
confidence_and_failure_mode.calibration_basis: Reliability measured on 240 labelled categorisations, 2026-Q2. Brier score 0.09.

reversal.how: Re-run categorisation with the corrected cause code and re-issue the slip notice to the programme board.
reversal.cheap_until_reason: Programme board pack lock for the September cycle.

artifacts.decision: Assess CR-PRG7-0104 as a 19-day schedule impact with 340k cost exposure, recommend absorption into the Q4 contingency rather than re-baselining.

basis.detail: Scope addition: two integration environments, requested by the security workstream
Critical path runs through integration test window, float 14d
Unallocated contingency 610k against a 340k exposure
Sponsor stated no further re-baselining before the December gate

alternatives.rejected_because: Sponsor position of 2026-06-11 rules out re-baselining before the December gate, and the contingency covers the exposure.
The two environments are a stated precondition of the security workstream sign-off recorded in RISK-PRG7-0031.

alternatives.option: Defer the decision to the December gate
alternatives.rejected_because: Procurement lead time for the environments is 14 weeks, so deferral pushes delivery past the March milestone.

confidence_and_failure_mode.failure_mode: If the 340k exposure excludes the licence uplift for the second environment, contingency cover is insufficient and the absorption recommendation is wrong. Detectable when the vendor quote lands, expected 2026-08-29.
confidence_and_failure_mode.calibration_basis: Reliability measured on 96 labelled impact assessments, 2026-H1. Brier score 0.14, over-confident above 0.9 so the reported figure is shrunk.

reversal.how: Withdraw the assessment from the change queue, re-run with the corrected cost basis, and re-notify the change authority chair.
reversal.cheap_until_reason: Change authority decision meeting; after approval the procurement commitment starts.

precedent_cases.outcome: Absorbed into contingency, no re-baseline, delivered on the original date
precedent_cases.relevance: Same sponsor, same objection to re-baselining, comparable exposure of 290k

precedent_cases.outcome: Rejected, security workstream escalated, reinstated six weeks later at higher cost
precedent_cases.relevance: Shows the cost of rejecting a security precondition on this programme

stakeholder_positions.position: No re-baselining before the December gate
Both environments required for sign-off
Contingency available but reportable above 250k

second_order_impacts.impact: Q4 contingency headroom falls below the 40 percent policy floor
Integration test window compresses, reducing defect-fix float

artifacts.recommendation: Recommend cancelling the PRG7 legacy-migration workstream at the October gate, subject to the vendor exit terms in section 4 of this pack.

options_with_costs.option: Continue to the December gate and re-assess
options_with_costs.cost: Additional 620k spend, exit fee unchanged, decision deferred 8 weeks

options_with_costs.option: Descope to the regulatory minimum and continue
options_with_costs.cost: Additional 1.1m, delivers 40 percent of the benefit case

basis.detail: Spend to date 2.1m against a 2.6m approved budget, 38 percent of scope delivered
Benefit case restated 2026-05, NPV now 0.4m against 3.9m at approval
Clause 11.4, exit fee 180k with 60 days notice

alternatives.reason: The October gate is the last point at which the 60-day notice period clears the contract year end, so the option set is fixed by clause 11.4.

confidence_and_failure_mode.failure_mode: If the regulatory deadline referenced in the benefit case moves left, the descope option becomes mandatory rather than optional and the cancellation recommendation is wrong. Detectable from the regulator's Q3 consultation response, due 2026-09-15.
confidence_and_failure_mode.calibration_basis: Reliability measured on 41 labelled preparation packs, 2025-2026. Brier score 0.19, small sample, treat the figure as indicative.

reversal.how: Withdraw the pack from the change authority agenda and re-issue with the revised regulatory position.
reversal.cheap_until_reason: Change authority papers issue two weeks before the October gate.

precedent_cases.outcome: Cancelled at gate, exit fee absorbed, forward saving realised
precedent_cases.relevance: Same vendor, same MSA clause, comparable scope completion at cancellation

stakeholder_positions.position: Open to cancellation if the exit fee is contained

second_order_impacts.impact: Two downstream workstreams lose their data-migration dependency and need re-planning
